Dear Ms. Yoshiko Ueda,
Thank you very much for your kind and high praise.

As a community-based animal hospital, we will continue to strive to provide compassionate care to pet owners and their beloved animal family members.

We look forward to your continued support.

The Staff of Shirokanedai Animal Medical Center

I took my cat to the vet because she had bumps on her stomach.

After examinations, it was determined to be a malignant tumor, and we were advised to remove one mammary gland, which we did.

At the same time, metastasis to the lymph nodes was found, and those were also removed. Because of the lymph node metastasis, she is still receiving chemotherapy after the surgery.

It's now been 7 months since the surgery, and she's doing well and living a healthy life.

During her hospital visits, I used ChatGPT as a second opinion because I was worried, and I believe they provided the best possible treatment, as they responded positively to both the cost and the treatment plan, indicating they were conscientious and reasonable.

My cat is very difficult and can be unruly, but the doctors and staff at the hospital were kind and friendly to both my cat and me.

They always listened carefully to my concerns without showing any displeasure, so I trust them completely.

I hope my cat will be healthy 5 or 10 years from now, and I expect to continue receiving care from them until then.

By the way, the photo is a portrait of my cat drawn by the doctor.

Seven months have passed since the surgery, and her weight has returned to normal.

Dear Alan,
Thank you for your valuable feedback. We take your comments seriously and will strive to provide even better medical care and service.

If it is not inconvenient for you, we would appreciate it if you could share your opinions with us at [amc.shirokanedai@gmail.com]. Your feedback will help us improve our medical care and services in the future.

There aren't many patients. 
I guess it's because it's expensive. I made a bad choice.

My child was examined urgently after a ligament tear. The doctor and nurses were very prompt, thorough in their examination and explanation of the surgical plan, and I was able to entrust my child to them without any worries. Two months after the injury, my child is running around happily as before. I am truly grateful. This is a truly trustworthy hospital. I look forward to continuing to use their services in the future.

I took my dog ​​in for an injection, but they suddenly put a muzzle on him. My dog ​​is very well-behaved and doesn't bite at all, and I understand they want to prevent any accidents, but this has never happened at any other hospital before. He's never worn a muzzle before, so it might actually be too stimulating and make him afraid of hospitals, but I don't think a doctor who acts like that is a professional.
